crossRefs.note: Yahweh your God will raise up to you a prophet from among you, of your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him.
For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.…
It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,
translations.bsb: Since that time, no prophet has risen in Israel like Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face—
translations.kjv: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
translations.asv: And there hath not arisen a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom Jehovah knew face to face,
